enrichment.headline: Hires P&A Administrative Services for employee benefit accounts, up to $90,000 a year through 2025
enrichment.summary: P&A Administrative Services, Inc. of Buffalo, NY, would administer the district's flexible spending accounts, dependent care assistance, transit benefits, COBRA continuation coverage and related billing. The agreement runs from March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025. Payments are capped at $90,000 per year and $270,000 over the whole term.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district hires Anthonio, Inc. of Oakland as the inspector of record for construction of the Laurel Child Development Center. The inspector provides daily reports, a punch list of unfinished items, and the paperwork for closing out the project with the Division of the State Architect (DSA), based on the state-approved drawings. The limit of $311,987 includes $28,362 set aside for additional services, and work is scheduled from February 24, 2022 to February 24, 2025. It is paid from Measure Y bond funds.

enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $16,775 to the district's agreement with ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. of Oakland, raising the limit from $7,260 to $24,035. The added work is an asbestos and lead survey and report for more buildings on the Claremont Middle School campus, tied to the multi-purpose room project, and includes $1,525 set aside for additional services. The agreement is also extended from January 31, 2022 to December 31, 2022 and is paid from Measure Y bond funds.
